summary: Lists the requirements that a middlebox communication (midcom) protocol must satisfy so applications can influence middlebox behavior. The focus is on network address translators and firewalls. It states needs rather than defining the protocol itself.

eli5.summary: Before building a tool, you write down what it must do. This document is that checklist for a protocol that lets programs ask firewalls to open the right doors.

questions: what are the midcom protocol requirements
how do applications control nat and firewalls
